chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad and Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan, from Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd, from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl, who said:
I heard Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام saying: “The Imams are scholars, truthful, granted understanding, and spoken to.”

key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةُ: the Imams, the divinely designated leaders
key_terms.مُحَدَّثُونَ: those spoken to or addressed beyond ordinary human learning
key_terms.مُفَهَّمُونَ: those granted understanding and made to comprehend

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean when it says the Imams are muḥaddathūn and granted understanding?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the Imams عليهم السلام with qualities of knowledge, truthfulness, divinely granted understanding, and being muḥaddathūn. It highlights their special rank in receiving insight and authoritative knowledge within Shia doctrine of Imamate.
